text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thanks for making the trip~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'll go drop off my luggage in my room,
so we can hold the meeting after that—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Maruzen!
Are your injuries completely healed?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yep♪ I'm in tip-top shape now!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Grass-chan seems to be doing
suuuper well lately too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Until I reach the place I have resolved to attain... I intend to continue dedicating myself to daily devotion."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Mhm. The look in your eyes right now is wonderful♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san...
No matter when I look at you, yours is such a broad back to follow.
choice_data_list: Still, the you of today won't be swallowed up!
Still, the you of today won't be swallowed up!

text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp is about to begin alongside
Grass Wonder, who has grown remarkably compared to last year!
